# Vendored ShellCheck

This directory contains ShellCheck `v0.11.0` for Linux x86_64.

`linux-x86_64/shellcheck` is copied from the official ShellCheck GitHub
release archive.

Use `tools/check-shell.sh` for ordinary repository shell checks.

Ordinary checks should not use network access or a system `shellcheck`.

License terms are in `LICENSE`.

Checksums and upstream release metadata are in `checksums.txt`.

Corresponding source is available from the upstream ShellCheck `v0.11.0` tag.
